3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.
**Job Description:**
**Marketing Specialist** **(m/f/x)**
**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
As an **Marketing Specialist** for the **Export team,** you will play an important role in supporting the delivery of marketing programs and sales enablement activities across international export markets. This is a highly execution-focused role that helps turn marketing plans into action by coordinating key activities, supporting channel partners, and ensuring the right tools, information, and materials are in place to support customer engagement.
You will be part of a small but high-impact team, working closely with stakeholders across divisions, business groups, channel partners, and countries. This role is well suited to someone who is looking to build or further develop their marketing career in an international environment and who enjoys working collaboratively, staying close to the detail, and helping keep multiple activities moving forward.
**Here, you will make an impact by:**
* Supporting the execution of activities aligned to the Export Markets marketing plan, including promotions and programs across channel and converter partners in a diverse range of markets
* Providing market insights and local analytics to support promotion optimization, program refinement, and account targeting
* Supporting 3M Representatives and Distributor Specialist Representatives by coordinating and distributing sales enablement materials, launch assets, and toolkits
* Assisting in the delivery of channel training programs, including managing invitations, coordinating calendars, liaising with speakers, and supporting follow-up activities
* Acting as a first point of contact for marketing-related customer mailbox enquiries, ensuring timely and professional responses
* Supporting portfolio availability across Export Markets, including product enquiries, restrictions, extensions, and listings in collaboration with operations teams
* Maintaining and updating online information relating to channel partners and converters across Export Markets
**Your Skills and Expertise**
To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who meet the following minimum requirements:
* Some relevant marketing experience, or a strong interest in transitioning into marketing with transferable skills and the aptitude to develop in the role
* Good understanding of core marketing principles and a willingness to build capability through hands-on experience
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across a range of teams and stakeholders
* A proactive and hands-on approach, with the willingness to take ownership of important coordination and execution tasks
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex international environment
* Good attention to detail and a disciplined approach to follow-up and execution
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken
Additional knowledge, skills, and qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
* Degree in Marketing or a related discipline or equivalent qualification
* Experience in digital, international, channel, partner, or trade marketing
* Experience using marketing technologies or digital tools
* A strong learning mindset and motivation to build a longer-term career in marketing within 3M
**Job specifics:**
* **Location Information -** Based at either our HQ in Bracknell, UK or Kajetany, Poland
* **Travel expectations -** May include up to 10% domestic/international
* **Working model -** This role has on-site working model, with the employee working at least four days a week in the office at Bracknell/Poland
* **Working pattern -** full time

**If so, we encourage you to apply and embark on a journey of creativity and growth with us.**

## About The Role
Purpose
This role supports the accurate, timely and controlled delivery of client, regulatory and investment performance reporting. Working as part of the Client Reporting & Performance team, the successful candidate will help manage recurring reporting cycles, validate data, investigate reporting queries, support performance reporting outputs and contribute to improvements in systems, controls and processes. The role is well suited to someone with early financial services experience who enjoys working with data, solving problems, improving processes and collaborating with stakeholders across Operations, Technology, Compliance, Investment and client-facing teams.
What you will learn: • How client, regulatory and performance reports are produced, checked and delivered. • How investment data, valuations, transactions, benchmarks and costs/charges feed into client reporting. • How reporting controls, reconciliations, procedures and audit trails support good client outcomes. • How approved AI, automation and productivity tools can be used responsibly to improve reporting processes. Key responsibilities
Client and regulatory reporting: • Support the end-to-end delivery of recurring client and regulatory reporting cycles, including preparation, data validation, testing, production oversight, despatch and archiving. Full training will be provided on the team’s reporting processes, controls and systems. • Coordinate reporting activity against agreed plans and SLAs, working with internal teams and external providers to resolve issues and keep delivery on track. • Help investigate reporting exceptions, data issues and enhancement requests, documenting findings clearly and escalating where needed. • Maintain daily BAU reporting controls, including MiFID II-related reporting activity, report settings, valuation data, transaction information, costs and charges, and other client-reporting outputs as required. • Support tax reporting processes, including data management, processing checks, production coordination and timely resolution of related queries. • Provide accurate, professional and client-focused responses to reporting queries from internal stakeholders and, where applicable, external parties.
Performance reporting and investment data: • Support monthly and quarterly performance reporting by helping collate, check and maintain performance and investment data. Over time, build knowledge of benchmarks, portfolio returns, flows, gain/loss reporting and attribution principles. • Investigate and resolve performance measurement queries, explaining data, calculation logic and reporting outcomes clearly to stakeholders. • Build knowledge of performance measurement concepts, including time-weighted returns, benchmarks, flows, gain/loss reporting and attribution principles. • Work with relevant teams to ensure investment data used in reporting is complete, accurate and aligned with agreed control procedures. Controls, process improvement and change • Maintain clear procedures, checklists and audit trails for reporting processes, ensuring controls are followed and documentation remains current. • Contribute to process improvements that improve accuracy, efficiency, scalability and the stakeholder experience. • Support testing, user acceptance activity and implementation of system changes, reporting enhancements and wider business initiatives. • Work with Technology, Operations and third-party providers to translate reporting issues into clear requirements and practical solutions. • Use data, workflow and productivity tools to improve reporting processes, reduce manual effort and strengthen quality assurance where appropriate.
Stakeholder and vendor management: • Build effective working relationships across Operations, Technology, Compliance, Investment, client-facing teams and external service providers. • Support the day-to-day relationship with third-party reporting and print/despatch providers, helping monitor SLAs, track issues and maintain clear communication during reporting cycles. • Prepare concise management information and status updates for reporting cycles, query trends, issues, risks and improvements. • Escalate risks, delays and control issues promptly, with clear recommendations and ownership of follow-up actions.
## About You
Knowledge, skills and experience Essential: • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, complete and high-quality outputs under deadline pressure. • Good numerical and analytical skills, with confidence investigating data issues and explaining findings clearly. • Confident Excel user, with experience working with data, reconciliations, templates or reports. Knowledge of lookups, pivot tables or similar tools would be useful. • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarise issues, updates and recommendations concisely. • Organised and delivery-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet recurring reporting deadlines. • Collaborative approach with the confidence to work across teams, ask good questions and follow issues through to conclusion. • A proactive mindset, with curiosity about how processes work and a willingness to identify improvements.
Desirable: • Experience with client reporting, regulatory reporting, performance reporting, investment data or wealth/asset-management operations. • Exposure to one or more of the following would be helpful but is not essential: investment operations, client reporting, regulatory reporting, portfolio data, reconciliations, valuations, transactions, benchmarks or performance reporting. • Familiarity with Pershing or similar custody/platform systems. • Experience using AI-enabled tools, Microsoft Copilot, automation or productivity technologies to improve reporting, analysis, documentation or workflow efficiency. • Completion of, or willingness to work towards, an industry qualification such as the Investment Operations Certificate or Investment Management Certificate.
AI, automation and continuous improvement: • The team is developing opportunities to use AI-enabled tools and automation to improve query management, reporting documentation, data checks and knowledge sharing. • The successful candidate will be encouraged to learn and apply approved AI and productivity tools responsibly, helping identify safe and practical ways to reduce manual effort, improve consistency and enhance reporting controls. • Prior experience with AI or automation is welcome but not essential; curiosity, good judgement and a controlled approach to using new technology are more important.
Personal qualities: • Accountable: takes ownership of tasks, follows through and escalates early when needed. • Curious: wants to understand how reports, data and systems fit together. • Precise: spots inconsistencies and is comfortable challenging unclear data or assumptions. • Collaborative: works well in a team environment and supports colleagues during peak reporting periods. • Adaptable: comfortable with deadlines, changing priorities and learning new processes. • Client-minded: understands that accurate reporting supports good client outcomes and regulatory expectations.
Qualifications: • Good standard of education, including Maths and English, or equivalent practical experience. • Relevant professional qualifications are advantageous but not essential if the candidate brings suitable experience and aptitude.
Working style and flexibility: • The role sits in a collaborative team environment where colleagues share knowledge and support each other during reporting peaks. • Some flexibility may be required around key reporting deadlines, with workload managed in line with HR policy and business need. • Cross-training will be provided across key client reporting, performance reporting and operational processes.

**Contract Type: Full Time, Permanent**

AALTO, a global leader in Stratospace. Based in Farnborough, AALTO is an Airbus subsidiary that manufactures, operates, and delivers services with its solar-powered, stratospheric platform: Zephyr.

As a **Senior Flight Physics Engineer**, you will take a leading role in shaping the performance, stability, controllability and safe operation of the Zephyr HAPS platform. Working across aerodynamics, flight dynamics, flight control laws, flight loads and simulation, you will turn complex engineering challenges into robust, certifiable solutions that support the continued evolution of an innovative, high-altitude autonomous aircraft.
This is a senior opportunity for an experienced aerospace engineer who is confident operating at the interface of analysis, design, software, flight test and certification. You will support the development and validation of flight physics capability for Zephyr, with particular focus on stability and control, flight control systems, guidance, navigation and control, flight dynamics modelling and flight test evidence.
You will work closely with software, avionics, systems, test and wider engineering teams to define requirements, mature architectures, assess performance and support safe flight test progression. · Lead the derivation, review and management of flight physics, flight control and system-level requirements, ensuring clear traceability from stakeholder needs through to verification evidence.
· Define, develop and refine flight control laws, automation algorithms and GNC architectures for autonomous high-altitude flight operations.
· Identify failure modes, assess handling qualities and develop robust contingency strategies that protect aircraft safety and mission continuity.
· Translate complex engineering intent into high-quality software and system requirements that are precise, testable and suitable for implementation by software and avionics teams.
· Manage interface and allocation requirements across onboard systems, ensuring flight physics assumptions and constraints are clearly understood across disciplines.
· Plan, support and analyse flight tests required for envelope expansion, stability and control validation, performance assessment and safe progression of test campaigns.
· Build, maintain and run flight dynamics simulation models, including MATLAB and Simulink-based analysis, to support design decisions, verification activity and flight test readiness.
· Analyse flight test telemetry and simulation outputs to identify trends, validate models, resolve anomalies and recommend practical engineering actions.
· Provide technical leadership within defined work packages, actively driving deliverables, managing technical risk and supporting delivery to agreed quality, cost and schedule targets.
· Collaborate with internal subject matter experts and wider engineering stakeholders, and support overseas flight trials when required.

· Degree or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Control Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or a closely related discipline.
· Significant experience in flight dynamics, stability and control, flight control systems or GNC within aerospace, aviation, autonomous aircraft, UAV, HAPS or a comparable safety-critical environment.
· Strong technical understanding of aircraft stability, flight dynamics, aerodynamics, control theory and flight control law development.
· Proficiency with MATLAB, Simulink and associated modelling, simulation and analysis toolsets.
· Experience defining requirements, supporting verification activity and producing clear technical documentation for complex engineering systems.
· Ability to interpret flight test data and telemetry, extract meaningful engineering insight and communicate recommendations that support safe test progression.

## Solutions Architect, 4G/5G NTN - Spacetime UK
# ****About Aalyria:****
Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.
## ****Role Overview:****

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. ###### About the Role
We're looking for someone to own how machine learning and AI run in production at Accelerant. You'll lead a small engineering function responsible for the platform our data scientists build on. That covers data and feature pipelines, training and inference services, deployment, monitoring, and the infrastructure behind our agentic AI work. You'll set the standards, coach the team, and be accountable for the whole thing staying up.
Much of the value in this role sits at the seams. Our machine learning systems are not an island. They need to exchange data and decisions with the wider Accelerant platform, with third-party providers, and with systems owned by other engineering teams. Designing those integrations, and building the working relationships with the people on the other side of them is closer to the centre of this job than any single piece of infrastructure.
We take the operational side seriously. We care about reproducibility, by which we mean knowing which data and which code produced any model currently making decisions. We care about training and serving computing features the same way, because the times they don't are the ones that hurt. We think about what we call the slow-label problem, where the ground truth on a claims or pricing model can arrive months or years after the prediction, and monitoring has to stay useful in the meantime. We have a bias toward dull, recoverable systems over clever ones that need someone awake to babysit them. If those are problems you've lived with rather than read about, we'd like to talk.
You'd be joining with some foundations already in place but without a decade of accumulated legacy to work around. There is meaningful scope to design the solution, and you'll be the person doing it.

* Making deployment routine rather than eventful. Versioning, staged rollout, rollback, and CI/CD for models and agents
* Building monitoring that separates data drift from pipeline breakage from genuine performance decay, and that stays informative when labels are delayed
* Standing up the infrastructure behind our agentic AI work, including orchestration, tool and API integration, retrieval and caching, and control of cost and latency
* Owning reliability, cost, and performance across ML workloads, from overnight batch scoring to low-latency services
* Building model governance and audit trails that satisfy regulators and internal risk committees without becoming a tax on design or delivery
* Leading and growing the function. Setting technical standards, coaching a small team, and partnering closely with the data scientists who depend on your work
###### What We're Looking For
You likely have experience with many of the following.
* Substantial experience running machine learning systems in production, including everything that happens after launch
* Strong engineering foundations. Python, infrastructure as code, containers and orchestration, and depth in at least one major cloud provider with sound instincts about cost and failure modes
* Data engineering capability, pipelines, orchestration, storage and access patterns, and enough SQL to hold your own in a warehouse
* A track record of integrating systems across organisational boundaries, including the part where you have to influence teams you don't manage
* Enough statistical literacy to have a real conversation with a data scientist about whether a model is working, and to stay skeptical when the dashboards say it is
* Experience leading or coaching engineers, plus judgement about which infrastructure will pay for itself and which is merely satisfying to build
* Willingness to work with LLMs and agentic AI as everyday tools, whatever your background is today
* The communication skills and credibility to be the person who says a system isn't ready
###### Bonus Points
Experience in one or more of the following is especially valuable:
* Building infrastructure for LLM and agentic systems, including serving, orchestration, retrieval, caching, and keeping spend and latency under control at scale
* Regulated industries where model governance, explainability, and audit trails are requirements rather than aspirations
* Insurance or financial services, whether pricing, underwriting, claims, or portfolio management
* Having worked as a data scientist or predictive modeller at some point, or otherwise being fluent in how models are built and not only how they're shipped
* Internal platforms and tooling that other technical teams genuinely adopted, and a clear view of why they adopted them
* Real-time or streaming systems, feature stores, or high-throughput scoring
###### Team Context
You'll join a lean, senior team with low bureaucracy and high autonomy, working alongside data scientists, engineers, actuaries, underwriters, and product managers. We're investing heavily in agentic AI as the next evolution of how a quantitative team operates, and this role helps shape that direction rather than inheriting it.
###### Why Accelerant?
You'll build the AI and ML foundations for a business where models drive real decisions across the insurance value chain at a company wholly bought into leveraging these systems.
You'll have
* Ownership of a function, the freedom to decide how it works, and a team of strong data scientists who need what you build

* Ensure the QMS is effectively implemented and maintained in compliance with ISO9001:2015, and other relevant standards.

* Minimum of 5 years' experience in a Quality Engineering role, with ideally a focus on supplier quality and experience in COPQ reduction, preferably within aerospace or manufacturing industries.

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and suppliers.

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. The Customer Success organisation is composed of three teams: Pre-sales, Customer Success, and Support. As a Customer Success Manager focused on Financial Services, you will play a critical role in driving product adoption and delivering ongoing value to our clients, working closely with the wider account team to positively impact net retention. # Project Evaluation Consultant Services Brief for Oswaldtwistle Mills Education and Heritage Project
By Amazing AccringtonAugust 11, 2026No Comments
**Re-opening and preserving the private collection at Oswaldtwistle Mill, which tells the story of the mill and its people, so it can be accessible to everyone, project-funded by the** **National Lottery Heritage Fund**
Oswaldtwistle Mill is seeking a freelance Project Evaluator as part of our project to preserve the historical documents of Moscow Mill and its community and make repairs so the Heritage Centre can reopen and be accessible to everyone.
As this contract is funded through a grant from the National Lottery Heritage Fund, it is essential that it is completed on time. No budget increase will be possible. Failure to complete the contract and submit the final report by the specified date will result in a reduction in the final instalment.
**About Oswaldtwistle Mill**
Oswaldtwistle Mills Home & Lifestyle Centre is a multi-award-winning shopping destination set in lovely grounds, offering a unique blend of retail therapy and leisure, with a large outdoor picnic area and a free, well-stocked wildfowl reserve. The former weaving mill has over 100 retailers showcasing famous name brands and several eateries. The Heritage Centre is housed within the mill, and thanks to funding through a grant from the National Lottery Heritage Fund, visitors will be able to engage with their heritage and the stories of survival of the mill.
**About Preserving the historical documents of Moscow Mill and its community, and making repairs and adjustments so the Heritage Centre can re-open and be accessible to everyone project.**
By the end of June 2027, the Heritage Centre will have reopened, the heritage will have been restored, and the site will be accessible to all. Volunteers and stakeholders will have been engaged throughout the process and offered heritage training to help protect the future of the heritage. The sustainability of the Heritage Centre will be supported initially through grants from Accrington Heritage Trust and subsequently from the new charity that is to be formed within this project.
This will be achieved by:
1. Organising the repair of the roof and the access door.
2. Advertising and recruitment of a freelance Project Manager to coordinate activities and tasks.
3. Advertising and recruitment of a freelance Multi-Lingual Project Manager to ensure the stories of the Asian community who worked in mills are included in the collection.
4. Packing up the collections in all rooms and logging them as they are packed. Initial cleaning, covering, and uncovering of the looms during the building works.
5. Sourcing secure storage – several metal lockable cupboards, packing materials and boxes.
6. Providing training, information and involvement of volunteers (up to 12) to be provided with four training sessions from Lancashire Archive. This will include Introduction to Collection Care & Packing collections, Basic Cataloguing of Collections Documentation, and Hazards in Museum Collections. These sessions will be delivered at the site.
7. Two days of supervision of volunteers to undertake cataloguing and packing.
8. Collaboration with the Steering Group to ensure ongoing support and smooth coordination of the project.
9. Collaboration with a local school to develop a modern education pack aligned with the current Local History topic within the curriculum for Years 1 and 2 that can be incorporated into their studies
10. Engagement with the Steering group, and 8 other local primary schools within the Mills footprint, community groups, Hyndburn Borough Council and stakeholders.
11. Working with Accrington Heritage Trust to apply for grants for the upkeep of the Heritage Centre until a charity can be formed, plus phase 2 funding.
***This work is supported by the National Lottery Heritage Fund.***
**About the invitation to tender**
Oswaldtwistle Mill is looking to appoint a Project Evaluator to work with the Managing Director to develop and implement an evaluation methodology for the project.
Proposals are welcome from individuals or consultancies with an understanding of heritage, a proven track record of working within funded projects, and experience of interpretation.
The following outputs will be required:
* A start-up meeting with key staff.
* Agreement on research methods and methodologies.
* Interim progress meetings.
* Delivery of the final report.
The contract will begin in summer 2026 and be completed by the end of summer 2027.
The anticipated budget is £6,000 to include all expenses and VAT. The payment schedule will be:
* 33% on signing the contract
* 33% in May 2027
* 33% on delivery of the final report to Oswaldtwistle Mill, late summer 2027

# Senior GTM Enablement Manager
Hybrid, London
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
## **About Enablement & the Role**
Enablement exists to be a strategic partner to our GTM roles—building role proficiency through clear, scalable programs that align to business priorities. We drive accountability and adoption so teams execute with confidence, deliver exceptional customer experiences, and achieve our revenue outcomes.
As **Senior Enablement Manager, EMEA**, you’ll be **Apollo’s first dedicated enablement hire in EMEA**, helping shape how enablement supports one of our most important growth regions.
You’ll serve as the strategic enablement partner and primary point of contact for EMEA Revenue, bridging global enablement and GTM strategy to local field execution. You’ll work closely with EMEA Sales Leadership and frontline managers to identify the highest-impact performance opportunities, strengthen seller and manager proficiency, and improve execution across the sales motion.
You’ll have primary field enablement responsibility for our EMEA Account Executive and Account Management teams and serve as the local enablement partner for BDRs, Solutions Consultants, GTM Engineers, and the broader EMEA Revenue organization.
As Apollo continues to grow and hire across EMEA, **new-hire onboarding and ramp will be a significant focus for this role.** You’ll partner closely with our Global Onboarding Program Manager to drive the global Revenue onboarding experience in EMEA, support new hires through their first 90 days, and ensure regional insights continuously improve the global program.
You’ll also partner closely with the North America-based Sales Enablement Manager and global functional partners to scale what works, maintain consistency where it matters, and ensure EMEA insights help shape our broader enablement strategy.
This is a senior individual contributor role with significant autonomy and influence. We’re looking for someone who can move comfortably from diagnosing a business problem to setting strategy, aligning senior stakeholders, building the solution, and driving measurable adoption and impact in the field.
## **What You’ll Do**
* **Partner with EMEA Sales Leadership:** Work directly with Sales Leadership and frontline managers to diagnose performance opportunities and improve pipeline quality, deal progression, win rates, and overall field execution.
* **Drive global onboarding in EMEA:** Partner closely with the Global Onboarding Program Manager to deliver and reinforce Apollo’s global Revenue onboarding program in EMEA, supporting new hires throughout their first 90 days and partnering with managers to drive successful ramp. Surface regional insights and feedback to continuously improve the global onboarding experience as Apollo scales.
* **Own ongoing & everboarding enablement:** Build and deliver ongoing development for EMEA AEs and AMs that strengthens seller proficiency and addresses evolving skill and execution gaps. Own regional certification and readiness, establishing and reinforcing a clear standard for what “good” looks like across EMEA.
* **Translate global strategy into regional execution:** Activate global enablement and GTM priorities across EMEA Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic teams, adapting execution to regional business and market needs.
* **Diagnose and improve field execution:** Use performance data, Gong insights, field observation, and active deals to identify seller and manager gaps, deliver targeted interventions, and scale what “good” looks like across teams.
* **Enable frontline managers:** Equip managers with practical frameworks, tools, and insights to inspect, coach, and reinforce consistent execution and sustainable behavior change.
* **Lead across teams:** Drive complex, cross-functional initiatives that shape how the field sells and executes the sales motion, aligning stakeholders and scaling best practices across Revenue and adjacent teams.
* **Partner across EMEA Revenue:** Serve as the regional enablement point of contact for BDRs, Solutions Consultants, GTM Engineers, and the broader Revenue organization, partnering with functional owners to activate global programs and priorities locally.
* **Modernize how we enable:** Champion AI-augmented enablement and modern GTM technology to create scalable, personalized, in-the-flow learning experiences, while bringing EMEA field insights back into global GTM and enablement strategy.
## **What We Look For**
* 5+ years of experience in Sales or Revenue Enablement, Field Enablement, Learning, Program Management, or a related GTM role, ideally in SaaS or another high-growth environment.
* Proven experience operating as a strategic partner to Sales Leadership and frontline managers, with a track record of improving seller execution and business performance.
* Experience supporting and activating global onboarding programs at the regional level, including partnering with program owners, frontline managers, and new hires to improve ramp and time to productivity.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives that have shaped how the field sells or how a GTM organization executes its sales motion.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous environments—identifying the problem, setting direction, aligning stakeholders, and driving work from strategy through execution and adoption.
* Proven ability to identify, codify, and scale best practices across teams, functions, and adjacent organizations.
* Deep experience with GTM technology and modern revenue workflows, including how technology supports prospecting, pipeline generation, deal execution, forecasting, and customer growth.

Astroscale UK is looking for an experienced Senior Mission Operations Engineer to join our team in Harwell. We require an additional person to join our team to take an active role in all phases of Astroscale’s current and future missions, such as ELSA-M and COSMIC.

We are looking for a candidate with a significant wealth of knowledge and experience in all aspects of both operations preparation activities and mission operations. Working under the direction of the Director of Data Analytics & AI, the role builds dashboards, prepares reports, and runs analyses across a wide range of topics — from growth to comms and standards/impact — and is the responsive for various requests coming from the Organization Objective working groups (NPs). # UK & US Master’s Applications-UK & US Master’s Applications
**Location:** London **Working pattern:** Hybrid -3 days per week in the London office **Employment:** Full-time **Salary**: £50,000–£65,000 base salary, plus performance-based bonus
**About Blue Education**
Blue Education is a premium education and university admissions consultancy supporting ambitious students applying to leading universities in the UK, US and around the world.
We provide highly personalised university admissions guidance, academic mentoring and long-term educational planning. Our team includes graduates and educators from Oxford, Cambridge, Ivy League and other world-leading universities, and we work with academically strong students seeking admission to highly competitive programmes.
As our postgraduate admissions work continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Graduate Admissions Consultant to work directly with students applying primarily for Master’s programmes in the UK and US.
**The Role**
This is a hands-on admissions consulting and mentoring position.
You will work one-to-one with students throughout the postgraduate application journey: helping them decide what and where to study, assess their competitiveness, strengthen their profile, develop an application strategy and present their academic and professional experience convincingly.
A significant part of the role involves providing detailed, substantive guidance on application materials. You will work closely with students on the content, structure, academic narrative, programme fit and positioning of their applications, often across multiple drafts.
We are looking for someone who enjoys working closely with students and has the judgement, experience and communication skills to provide exceptional postgraduate admissions guidance.
**What You Will Do**
**1. Application Strategy & Programme Selection**
Develop an individual postgraduate admissions strategy for each student based on their academic background, interests, experience and longer-term goals.
* Assess students’ academic records, research, internships, professional experience and extracurricular activities.
* Understand their academic interests and career ambitions.
* Help students clarify what they should study when they are considering different subjects or directions.
* Research and recommend appropriate Master’s programmes in the UK and US.
* Develop ambitious but realistic university and programme lists.
* Assess how competitive a student is for individual programmes.
* Explain how different programmes and admissions committees are likely to evaluate their profile.
* Identify weaknesses or gaps in their candidacy and recommend practical ways to address them.
* Develop a coherent overall strategy connecting the student’s previous experience, current interests and future ambitions.
You should be able to explain not simply where a student should apply, but why a particular programme fits them and what they need to do to become a stronger candidate.
**2. Student Mentoring & Profile Development**
Build strong one-to-one mentoring relationships with students throughout their postgraduate application journey.
For students who begin working with Blue Education before the application cycle, you may advise on areas including:
* Academic development and course selection;
* Further reading and independent academic work;
* Research opportunities;
* Internships and professional experience;
* Relevant extracurricular activities;
* Relationships with potential academic referees;
* GRE or GMAT preparation where appropriate;
* Broader academic and career direction.
You will meet students regularly, review their progress and adapt their strategy as their profile and ambitions develop.
Our objective is to help students become stronger applicants, not simply complete an application process.
**3. Detailed Guidance on Application Materials**
Provide detailed, hands-on advice on the content and positioning of students’ application materials.
These may include:
* Statements of Purpose;
* Personal Statements;
* Academic and professional CVs;
* Supplementary essays and application questions;
* Recommendation strategy;
* Research proposals where relevant;
* Scholarship applications.
You will work with students through multiple drafts and provide specific, actionable feedback on both what they are saying and how they are positioning themselves.
**You will help students:**
* Identify the academic, research, professional and extracurricular experiences most relevant to their application.
* Decide what should be emphasised, developed, reduced or removed.
* Build a coherent narrative connecting their previous experience, current academic interests and future goals.
* Articulate intellectual interests with sufficient depth and specificity.
* Explain convincingly why they want to pursue a particular programme.
* Demonstrate meaningful programme fit.
* Position research, internships, employment and other experiences effectively.
* Select appropriate evidence and examples to support the claims they make.
* Address changes in academic direction or unusual aspects of their profile where necessary.
* Improve the logic, coherence and overall persuasiveness of the application.
* Ensure that different parts of the application reinforce one another.
You should be comfortable identifying weak arguments, underdeveloped examples, unclear motivations and ineffective positioning, and giving students detailed guidance on how to improve them. The emphasis is on close engagement with the substance of each application and feedback that materially improves the student’s thinking, positioning and final submission.
**4. Application Management & Interview Preparation**
Guide students through the complete postgraduate application process.
This includes:
* Developing application timelines and priorities.
* Monitoring university and programme deadlines.
* Ensuring students understand programme-specific requirements.
* Advising on referee selection and recommendation strategy.
* Reviewing the overall consistency and readiness of applications before submission.
* Helping students manage overlapping deadlines and changing application plans.
* Preparing students for postgraduate admissions interviews where required.
Interview preparation may involve mock interviews, discussion of academic interests and previous research, challenging students on their motivations and conducting practice with unfamiliar or difficult questions. The aim is to help students communicate their ideas with greater clarity, confidence and intellectual depth.
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for someone with strong academic credentials, excellent admissions judgement and meaningful professional experience supporting competitive postgraduate applications.
**Essential Requirements**
**Academic Background**
A degree from a highly selective, globally leading university is required.
We are particularly interested in graduates of:
* Oxford or Cambridge;
* Ivy League universities;
* Stanford;
* MIT;
or institutions of comparable international academic standing and selectivity.
A postgraduate degree is advantageous but not essential.
**Professional Experience**
* Approximately 3–5 years of directly relevant experience in postgraduate admissions consulting, university admissions advising or high-level education consulting.
* Substantial experience supporting students applying to competitive Master’s programmes.
* Strong knowledge of both UK and US postgraduate admissions.
* Experience advising applicants targeting highly selective universities and programmes.
* Admissions Judgement
* You should be able to look at a student’s profile and form a clear independent view about:
* Which programmes genuinely suit them;
* Where they should apply;
* Which options are realistic and where they could be more ambitious;
* What is missing from their profile;
* How they can strengthen their candidacy;
* Which experiences should form the centre of their application;
* How they should position themselves to an admissions committee.
We are looking for strong professional judgement and the ability to develop genuinely individualised strategies for each student.
**Communication & Mentoring**
**You should have:**
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong one-to-one mentoring skills.
* The confidence to challenge ambitious students constructively.
* The ability to explain complicated admissions decisions clearly.
* Strong analytical reading skills.
* The ability to give detailed, specific and actionable feedback on written applications.
* Strong interpersonal skills when working with students and, where appropriate, their families.
**Organisation & Ownership**
You should be highly organised, reliable and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple applications and deadlines simultaneously.
You will be expected to take ownership of individual student cases and work independently while maintaining consistently high standards.
**Nice to Have**
The following would be advantageous:
* Experience advising on MBA applications.
* Familiarity with leading UK, US and European MBA programmes.
* Knowledge of GMAT and GRE requirements.
* Experience with research-intensive Master’s applications.
* Experience supporting applicants across a range of academic disciplines.
* Experience studying or working in both the UK and US.
* Experience working with international students.
* Mandarin Chinese language ability.
* Experience working with Chinese students or families.
**What Success Looks Like**
A successful Graduate Admissions Consultant will:
* Develop thoughtful, individualised application strategies.
* Build trusted relationships with students and provide clear, honest advice.
* Help students make better decisions about what and where to study.
* Identify weaknesses early enough for students to address them.
* Provide detailed, actionable guidance that materially improves application content and positioning.
* Maintain high standards across multiple student cases and application deadlines.
* Receive strong feedback from students and families.
* Contribute to strong admissions outcomes at highly selective universities.
The best consultants do more than improve the final application. They help students understand what makes them a compelling candidate and how to communicate that convincingly.
**Why Join Blue Education?**
You will work with ambitious students targeting some of the world’s most competitive postgraduate programmes and have the opportunity to engage deeply with their academic decisions, application strategies and written materials.
**Blue Education offers:**
* £50,000–£65,000 base salary plus performance-based bonus;
* High-touch, intellectually engaging student work;
* The opportunity to focus on postgraduate admissions consulting and develop deep expertise in the field;
* An academically strong international team;
* Hybrid working, with three days per week in our London office;
* Professional development opportunities;
* Company pension and other UK employee benefits.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required during peak application periods or when supporting students across international time zones.

Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
What You'll Do
The Global Product Director – Productivity Tools leads the strategy, vision, and delivery of BCG's global Productivity Tools portfolio. This portfolio supports some of the firm's most widely used applications - including Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, OneNote, Adobe products, and productivity add-ins such as think-cell and Efficient Elements, across Windows, Mac, and mobile platforms. You will ensure these products remain secure, modern, reliable, and intuitive, enabling thousands of BCGers to work more effectively every day. Working within Tech@BCG, you will define the long-term product strategy while balancing innovation, operational excellence, and platform sustainability. You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, security, UX, support, and business stakeholders to shape the future of the productivity experience at BCG. Through strategic product leadership, customer engagement, and data-driven decision making, you will lead a cross-functional squad to continuously evolve a portfolio of 20+ global products that enable BCG's consultants and business teams to deliver their best work. Define and own the long-term product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for BCG's global Productivity Tools portfolio, ensuring alignment with Tech@BCG priorities and evolving business needs. Develop and communicate a clear product strategy that balances user experience, innovation, operational resilience, security, technical sustainability, and business value across a portfolio of 20+ global products. Lead the evolution of productivity products across Windows, Mac, and mobile platforms, balancing strategic investment with operational stability and continuous improvement. Champion a customer-centric product culture by engaging regularly with consultants, business functions, leadership, and support teams to understand user needs, validate assumptions, gather feedback, and translate insights into a prioritized product backlog and roadmap. Drive improvements to user experience, product performance, reliability, and adoption through data-informed product decisions, user research, telemetry, operational analytics, and customer insights. Establish product success measures and use product health metrics, operational KPIs, customer satisfaction, and usage analytics to continuously evaluate outcomes, prioritize investments, and shape future strategy. Partner with Engineering, Architecture, UX, Security, Platform Engineering, and Operations to deliver scalable, secure, resilient, and high-quality product capabilities. Champion automation across product lifecycle management, software governance, license optimization, deployment, operational processes, and AI-enabled capabilities to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the user experience. Lead product lifecycle activities including product updates, release management, vendor engagement, compatibility planning, platform modernization, and strategic technology adoption. Provide product leadership for a multidisciplinary squad of approximately 10 professionals while directly managing a Product Analyst, fostering collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous development across the team. What You'll Bring
Extensive experience (5+ years) leading the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of enterprise software products or digital workplace platforms in a complex global environment. Proven ability to define product vision, translate business and customer needs into strategic roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes through cross-functional teams. Strong product management expertise with a customer-centric mindset, using user research, analytics, telemetry, and feedback to shape product direction and investment decisions. Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary product teams and influencing engineering, architecture, security, UX, and business stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority. Experience managing large-scale SaaS or productivity platforms, ideally including Microsoft 365, Adobe technologies, or comparable enterprise productivity ecosystems. Strong commercial and technical judgment, with the ability to balance innovation, operational excellence, platform sustainability, security, and user experience. Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment, and lead change across a global organization. Who You'll Work With
You'll be part of Tech@BCG, working within a global product organization responsible for delivering the digital workplace experiences that enable BCGers to do their best work every day. You will partner closely with Product Owners, Engineering Chapter Leads, Architects, UX designers, Platform and Operations Engineers, the Change and Communications team, Security, Enterprise Architecture, and support teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing productivity solutions. You'll also collaborate extensively with Microsoft, Adobe, and other strategic technology partners, as well as business stakeholders across BCG's global offices. Regular engagement with consultants, business functions, and leadership teams will be central to understanding evolving user needs, validating product direction, and ensuring the Productivity Tools portfolio continues to deliver measurable value across the firm.

# Senior Warehouse Operations Manager
Hemel Hempstead (Onsite)
For us, tech has never been about just hardware or software. It’s about people. It’s our meaningful relationships, deep expertise and practical know-how in technology that drive what we do. We put our customers, our partners and the environment at the heart of everything we do and our people are the difference that make the difference.
At boxxe, we understand, we collaborate, we simplify, we care and we deliver; together we are making tech human.
**What you’ll be doing**
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Warehouse Operations Manager to provide senior operational leadership across our warehouse and inventory operations in Hemel Hempstead and York. This elevated role will be responsible for driving performance, strengthening operational controls, improving inventory accuracy, and supporting the continued development of a scalable, well-controlled multi-site warehouse operation.
The role will have a particular focus on Hemel Hempstead, where increasing configuration activity, higher-volume deliveries, secure handling requirements, and more complex customer fulfilment require visible senior leadership several days each week. The postholder will lead configuration from a warehouse operations perspective, ensuring the site has the right processes, controls, space, resource planning, stock discipline, and dispatch readiness to support accurate and efficient output.
The successful candidate will also travel regularly to York to maintain consistency across sites, support the different operational requirements at York, engage directly with local teams, and ensure shared standards are embedded across the warehouse network.
This role will suit someone who combines strong warehouse leadership with a detailed understanding of inventory control, process compliance, continuous improvement, multi-site operational management, and complex logistics requirements.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop warehouse supervisors and the inventory team, creating clear accountability, strong communication, and a high-performance culture across all areas of responsibility.
* Provide senior leadership across the York and Hemel Hempstead warehouse operations, with direct accountability for warehouse performance, inventory control, operational standards, and the continued development of a scalable, well-controlled multi-site operation.
* Oversee inventory management, stock accuracy, cycle counts, investigations, and controls to ensure stock remains organised, visible, and reliable across all warehouse locations, including offsite storage and stock held at third-party warehouses.
* Ensure warehouse workflows, resource planning, shift patterns, and operational priorities support service levels, order fulfilment, configuration activity, stock control, and customer commitments.
* Lead configuration activity from a warehouse operations perspective, ensuring warehouse processes, space planning, resource allocation, stock control, handling standards, and dispatch readiness support efficient and accurate configuration output.
* Monitor performance against key operational and inventory KPIs, including order accuracy, on-time dispatch, stock accuracy, productivity, put-away performance, picking accuracy, and aged stock management.
* Identify operational risks, capacity constraints, process gaps, and performance issues, implementing practical improvements that increase efficiency, control, and cost-effectiveness.
* Develop, embed, and maintain consistent standard operating procedures across warehouse and inventory activities, ensuring teams follow agreed processes for receiving, put-away, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, stock movements, and adjustments.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure operational plans support customer requirements, commercial priorities, supplier activity, and wider business objectives.
* Provide senior operational expertise in complex logistics requirements, including secure and sited deliveries, international shipments, labelling and compliance requirements, same-day activity, container movements, shipment rules and regulations, and the management of deliveries from third-party facilities.
* Support the future development of the role to include broader logistics ownership, including export activity and complex shipment management, as the operation continues to evolve.
* Maintain strong health and safety standards across warehouse locations, promoting a proactive safety culture through audits, training, risk assessments, and clear management expectations.
* Maintain regular senior presence at Hemel Hempstead and York in line with the expectations of the role, ensuring operational issues are understood, prioritised, and resolved quickly at site level.
**Requirements**
* Proven experience in a senior warehouse operations role, ideally across multiple sites or within a complex operational environment.
* Strong people management experience, including leading supervisors, team leaders, or inventory teams.
* Detailed understanding of warehouse workflows, inventory control, stock accuracy, WMS systems, goods-in, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and stock adjustment processes.
* Strong knowledge of logistics and complex shipment requirements, including secure deliveries, sited delivery activity, international and export movements, labelling standards, same-day shipments, container handling, rules and regulations, and third-party facility dispatches.
* Ability to work in a hybrid, multi-site role, with a regular presence at Hemel Hempstead several days each week and travel to York for at least two days every two weeks.
* Experience implementing standardised processes, improving operational controls, and driving continuous improvement across warehouse and inventory functions.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and KPIs to identify issues and improve performance.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence, engage, and collaborate with colleagues across operations, commercial, customer service, and leadership teams.
* Knowledge of health and safety requirements, risk assessments, warehouse compliance standards, and safe systems of work.

# Police Officer - Inner London
## Job Introduction
###### **Now Recruiting Police Officers in Central London – Build a Career That Makes a Difference**
*"BTP truly is a unique police force with a real family feel. We care deeply about what we do; serving the public and supporting our people. Our work matters. If you want to make a positive difference to the millions of people who use the network every day, BTP is the place for you."***– Chris Casey, Divisional Commander, London and South East England**
We are recruiting Police Officers within Inner London. Locations include, but are not limited to, stations such as Kings Cross, Euston, Wembley, Croydon, Clapham Junction, West Ham, Waterloo and Stratford.
Please note: You cannot specify a particular Inner London location. However, postings will be considered alongside where you live wherever operationally possible.
## # Could this be the role for you?
As a Police Officer with British Transport Police, you'll play a vital role in helping keep millions of passengers, railway staff and members of the public safe every day. This is a career where no two days are the same, and where your actions can have a lasting impact on individuals, families and communities.
Whether you're supporting a vulnerable person in crisis, helping reunite a child with their family, responding to an emergency, investigating crime or reassuring someone during one of the most difficult moments of their life, you'll be making a meaningful difference to people every day.
You'll never face these challenges alone. From your first day of training, you'll be supported by colleagues, supervisors and mentors who are committed to helping you develop, succeed and thrive in your career.
We offer one of the highest starting salaries for Police Constables across England and Wales, alongside excellent benefits, structured career development and opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.
## # What you'll get in return
We recognise that a successful policing career is about more than salary alone. At British Transport Police, you'll benefit from competitive pay, strong family-friendly policies, ongoing development opportunities and a range of wellbeing initiatives designed to support you both professionally and personally.
* **Starting salary:** £32,472, rising year on year to £50,256 after five years
* **London allowances:** £8,738 (£5,588 London Allowance plus £3,150 London Weighting) from day one of training
* Oyster card for personal and professional use
* 25 days annual leave, increasing with service
* A highly competitive Career Average Revalued Earnings (CARE) pension scheme
* Voucher and incentive schemes, including cycle-to-work and a wide range of retail discounts
* Continued investment in learning, supported by dedicated in-house talent and development teams
* Clear promotion and career development opportunities across a range of policing specialisms
* Specialist support from Occupational Health and wellbeing services
* Free eyesight tests
* Eligibility for the Blue Light Card
* Membership of the Police Federation from day one
* Strong support for work-life balance, including 26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave, alongside paternity leave, carers' leave, adoption leave and special leave provisions
## # You will not be eligible to apply if
* You have been unsuccessful following your application, testing or interview for Police Officer, Special Constable or PCSO and have not yet completed the three-month reapplication period.
* You have been unsuccessful following BTP vetting checks within the last 12 months.
* You have ever received a custodial sentence, including suspended sentences.
* You have previously been dismissed from another police force or are subject to a live misconduct investigation.
* You are bankrupt, have a County Court Judgment, or an unmanaged Individual Voluntary Arrangement.
* You have tattoos deemed offensive (face and neck tattoos are considered on a case-by-case basis).
* You do not have permanent right to live and work in the UK.
* You have not resided continuously in the UK for the past three years.
## # What we're looking for
You don't need previous policing experience to join us. We welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences and stages of life.
Whether you're changing careers, returning to work, leaving education or looking for a fresh challenge, we'll provide the training, support and development you need to succeed.
We know that great police officers come from all walks of life. Some join us straight from education, while others bring valuable experience from careers in healthcare, retail, customer service, hospitality, the military and many other professions. If you care about people, enjoy working as part of a team and want to make a positive difference, we'd love to hear from you.
While every day brings different challenges, successful officers are often people who can communicate effectively, remain calm under pressure and build positive relationships with a wide range of people.
**Key qualities include:**
* **Strong communication skills**
* **Good judgement and problem-solving ability**
* **Empathy and emotional resilience**
* **The ability to build trust and remain calm under pressure**
You'll receive comprehensive training and support from day one, helping you build the skills and confidence needed to succeed in the role.
As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to specialise in areas such as CID, Counter Terrorism and County Lines. Whether you aspire to become a detective, move into a specialist unit, develop as a leader or continue building expertise in frontline policing, we'll support your ambitions every step of the way.
## # Want to apply?
Applications are completed online.
As part of the process, you will be required to complete a Situational Judgement Test (SJT). If you do not pass the SJT, your application will not progress at this time, though you may reapply once the reapplication period allows.
You are encouraged, though not required, to attend a question-and-answer session to learn more about the role, life at BTP and the recruitment process.
Please note: This campaign is for new recruits only. Transferees should apply through a transferee-specific vacancy when available.
Successful applicants will join a conditional offer pool and be considered for opportunities for up to 12 months from the date of their conditional offer.
## # Equality, Diversity and Inclusion
We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to thrive.
We believe our people are strongest when they reflect the diverse communities we serve. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work.
We are committed to attracting talented people from all backgrounds and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. Whatever your background, identity or experience, you'll be supported throughout the recruitment process and beyond.
If you're excited by the opportunity to make a difference but are unsure whether policing is for you, we encourage you to apply and learn more about what a career with BTP can offer.
Reasonable adjustments are available throughout every stage of the recruitment process.
## # Use of AI in applications
AI can be a useful tool to help organise thoughts or generate ideas, but we want to hear your genuine voice. Personal experiences, authentic motivation and individual insight are what stand out most to us.

For support or assistance with your application, contact the recruitment team via the BTP Recruitment Inbox.

# Strategic Business Partner (HR)
## Are you passionate about people, culture and sustainability? Join our People's team to shape our people strategy, enable leaders and support our mission for environmental action.
***About CDP:***
CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.
Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. We helped more than 24,800 companies and almost 1,000 cities, states and regions disclose their environmental impacts in 2024. Financial institutions with more than a quarter of the world’s institutional assets use CDP data to help inform investment and lending decisions.
Our team is truly global, united by our shared desire to build a world where people, planet and profit are balanced. Visit cdp.net or follow us @CDP to find out more.
***About the Team:***
The People & Workplace Experience function ensures CDP’s ‘People First’ ethos is a reality, both for our team and our guests. Spanning everything to do with our People and Culture, our physical workspaces and the ways we communicate, we ensure there is the focus, guidance and processes in place, leading to an engaged team who can deliver at their best.
The People Planning & Business Partnering team are a group of qualified and experienced specialists, governing the delivery of the People Plan, acting as strategic partners to Functional leaders, and ensuring interlock and seamless delivery into the various geos to ensure desired outcomes are achieved.
***About this role:***
Act as strategic Business Partner to Leadership Team members, and sit as part of their extended management teams. You’ll use your experience to orchestrate work with and through the wider people team to deliver longer term goals and change through the functions and regions to align with CDP strategic priorities.
***What you will do:***• Deliver against functional priorities and provide proactive advisory support and coaching to the business in areas such as Workforce Planning, Organisation Design, Change Management, Talent Attraction and Onboarding, Talent Management, Employee Engagement, Employee Relations, Performance Management, Rewards planning etc. Utilizes HR best practice and knowledge of requirements across different jurisdictions to navigate delivery of organisational plans
• Provides strategic support and advice to functional leaders (client group to be confirmed) and joined up support to the organisation across multiple functions and time zones. Focusses on a great experience for managers and teams members.
• Ensures consistent application of CDP tools, skills and knowledge in respective teams through delivery of People Plan projects as required
• Acts as change management champion for the team, highlighting opportunities to change – aiming for simplicity and great experience.
Actively contribute to an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:
• Ensuring you know what is expected of you, through regular 1:1’s, having clear objectives in place, and participating in open and honest performance and development conversations.
• Ensuring a respectful and inclusive workplace, where team members communicate openly, share knowledge so it can be used, and respect difference.
• Living the CDP Values and demonstrating the behaviours appropriate to your position.
Internal stakeholders include: functional leaders (LT) and their direct reports. People Experience team.
External stakeholders include: legal counsel, service providers.
***We're looking for:***
• Significant experience in HR and as a HRBP across multiple jurisdictions in a matrix environment.
• Experience of partnering within commercial sales / go-to-market teams, or with Data/Technology teams.
• Strong management skills, with the ability to motivate and develop a team
• Experience across a number of HR disciplines / processes.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels of the organization.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically
• Strong knowledge of employment laws and regulations across multiple geos.
• Detailed and conceptual thinking skills to analyze sophisticated problems and propose solutions.
• Strong attention to detail.
**Salary and benefits**: The salary banding for this role is £78,969 - £90,000/year, 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, generous non-contributory pension provision, Employee Assistance Programme, life assurance, training and development, flexible working opportunities and other benefits.
Final offer amount depends on multiple factors such as candidates experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data.
This is a permanent role based at CDP’s London office. Interested applicants must be eligible to work legally in the UK and live within a commutable distance of the London office and be comfortable with 2 days in the office per week. We cannot sponsor this role.

# Senior Data Engineer (Remote within the UK)
## At Chip, our mission is to make our customers wealthier. An app to build your long-term wealth across savings, investments and pensions.
We usually respond within three days
As a Senior Data Engineer at Chip, you'll help bring our data platform to the next level and empower Chip to be a truly data-driven business. You'll co-own the architecture of our data platform alongside our Analytics Engineer — not just implementing designs, but making the calls on how ingestion, modelling, and the semantic layer should actually work. You'll also provide technical leadership across the wider data engineering team as we grow.
**What you can expect to be doing:**
**Architecture & Pipeline Design**
* Design, build, and run scalable, secure data pipelines across multiple sources — with an eye on compute sizing and query performance
* Co-own architecture decisions across ingestion, modelling, and the presentation layer — defining how the platform should work, not just building to spec
* Design and evolve our medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) as the platform matures
**Engineering Standards**
* Define more detailed engineering standards — naming conventions, partitioning, testing strategy, contract templates
* Apply Databricks best practices and Infrastructure as Code across the platform
**Data Governance**
* Own governance patterns in Unity Catalog — permissions, access models, and how we handle sensitive data
* Set technical governance standards the rest of the team builds against
**Enablement & Self-Service**
* Enable downstream consumers with self-service patterns, so the data team isn't the bottleneck for every request
**Technical Leadership & Mentoring**
* Provide technical leadership across the data engineering team — mentoring other engineers, reviewing code, and raising the engineering bar
**What we’re looking for:**
* Data engineering: You've built and scaled complex data products in a growing environment — you've seen platforms mature past their early ad hoc stage and know what that evolution actually takes.
* Databricks expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Databricks platform end to end — workspace and compute configuration, governance, orchestration, user management, engineering best practices.
* Data modelling: You're comfortable designing schemas and data models, including medallion architecture and Kimball/Star Schema concepts (Fact and Dimension tables), from the ground up.
* Git: You're fluent in Git workflows — branching, troubleshooting, code reviews.
* Python/PySpark/SQL: You write clean, efficient code across all three, and you understand how it performs at scale.
* Database management: Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., Redshift, Postgres, MongoDB), with a solid grounding in database fundamentals — indexing, performance, design trade-offs.
* Terraform: You have experience in managing infrastructure as code with Terraform.
* Mentoring: You've supported and grown less experienced engineers before, and enjoy doing it.
* Architecture ownership: You design systems, not just implement them — you can reason through trade-offs and defend a decision.
* Data governance: You understand PII handling and governance patterns, and build them into your designs by default.
**Nice to have:**
* **Previous experience in fintech**
* **Experience re-architecting a data platform from the ground up**
* **Experience building and training AI/ML models**
* **Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional (or equivalent)**
* **Proficiency in building streaming data processing systems**
* **Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud services (AWS, GCP)**
**What we’re really looking for:** ✍️
We’re looking for someone who’s genuinely excited about Chip and energised by the opportunity to help build the future of wealth, making saving, investing and pensions simpler and more accessible for everyone.
We work in a regulated space, so the bar is high. But we’ve built a team of smart, thoughtful people who care about doing great work and enjoy doing it together. Technical skills matter, obviously. But they’re not the only thing we hire for.
We want real people. People with interests, perspective and personality. The best teams are made up of individuals who bring different experiences into the room, not just polished CVs and good interview answers.
So alongside the technical side, we’ll be looking for empathy, self-awareness, sound judgement, resilience and a collaborative mindset. People who are good to work with, especially when things get hard.
⏰ **Working Hours** ⏰
* **Monday to Thursday:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
* **Friday:** 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Start your weekend early!)
Enjoy a **structured yet balanced** workweek, with an early Friday finish to kickstart your weekend!
**PERKS** 🎁
* £70,000 - £80,000 per annum
* Discretionary Performance-Related Annual Bonus.
* Workplace pension scheme - We invest in your future with a **workplace pension scheme**, contributing **5% on earnings up to £50,000**. Plan ahead with confidence while you grow your career! 🚀
* Private medical insurance (medical history disregarded)

* Annual training budget for courses, workshops, or conferences to help you advance your career.

* Company laptop
