## WHO ARE WE
Cognism is the leading provider of European B2B data and sales intelligence. Ambitious businesses of every size use our platform to discover, connect, and engage with qualified decision-makers faster and close more deals. Headquartered in London with global offices, Cognism’s contact data and contextual signals are trusted by thousands of revenue teams to eliminate the guesswork from prospecting.
As an IT Support Specialist, you will provide first-level technical support to employees across the Cognism group, ensuring seamless IT operations. You will play a crucial role in troubleshooting technical issues, managing IT assets, and supporting both office-based and remote employees with their IT needs.
**YOUR CHALLENGES & OPPORTUNITIES**
* **Provide IT Support & Troubleshooting** – Act as the first point of contact for IT support, assisting employees with technical issues across multiple locations.
* **Manage IT Systems & SaaS Applications** – Support workplace systems (endpoints) and IT solutions, ensuring employees have the tools they need to perform effectively.
* **Optimize IT Asset Management** – Maintain an up-to-date inventory of IT equipment, ensuring timely procurement and replacement of faulty hardware.
* **Enhance Cybersecurity Compliance** – Collaborate with security teams to monitor alerts, resolve security issues, and ensure best practices are followed.
* **Improve IT Documentation & Processes** – Standardize and document IT processes, troubleshooting guides, and configuration procedures to enhance efficiency.
* **Support Onboarding & Offboarding** – Work closely with HR Operations to set up IT equipment and user accounts for new joiners and ensure smooth offboarding processes.
* **Manage Network & Connectivity** – Administer and troubleshoot Wi-Fi networks, ensuring reliable connectivity for office and remote users.
* **Deliver Event & AV Support** – Provide IT and AV support for in-office events, ensuring seamless setup and operation of multimedia equipment.
**OUR EXPECTATIONS**
* **Professional Experience** – Minimum 3 years of experience in an IT support or helpdesk role, managing remote support across multiple time zones.
* **Technical Expertise** – Strong knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems, Microsoft 365, and common SaaS applications.
* **Network & Security Skills** – Experience with network troubleshooting, Wi-Fi management, and basic firewall administration.
* **Customer-Focused Approach** – Strong service orientation, ensuring operational excellence and high user satisfaction.
* **Collaboration & Communication** – Ability to work closely with IT teams across different regions and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
* **Problem-Solving Mindset** – Proactive, solution-driven, and adaptable to a fast-paced environment.
* **Organizational Skills** – Strong ability to track IT assets, manage tickets efficiently, and document processes for knowledge sharing.
* **Certifications (Preferred)** – CompTIA A+ and ITIL Certification are highly desirable.
**OUR TECH STACK**
* **Operating Systems** – Windows & macOS
* **Productivity & Collaboration Tools** – Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian Suite
* **IT & Security Management** – Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Autopilot
* **Networking & Infrastructure** – Wi-Fi networks, firewall administration
* **IT Support Tools** – IT ticketing systems, remote support software

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Good communication skills and confidence working as part of a team.
An interest in furniture, materials, manufacturing and commercial interior design.
A proactive attitude and willingness to learn.

Get the TMF right, and inspections go smoothly, submissions move forward, and study teams can focus on the science instead of scrambling for documentation. You'll work closely alongside the Associate Director as a trusted partner on project management and TMF Operations standards, including people management, processes, and systems.

You'll provide oversight and hands-on management for a team supporting TMF operations across all of CSL's therapeutic areas, reporting to the Associate Director, TMF Operations — Portfolio Development Excellence, Process and Compliance. In practice, that means:
* **TMF Governance & Process Management** – Develop and implement TMF oversight processes, support study teams with TMF tools, and drive updates to TMF-related processes and standards.

**Have you always had an itch to scratch when it comes to helping dogs? We’re looking for someone who can provide our dogs with the highest level of care and enrichment, as they prepare for their forever home.
## What does this role do?
As Dog Welfare Assistant, you’ll:
* provide daily care to the dogs in the rehoming centre, working to Dogs Trust's code of practice and Health and Safety guidelines,
* educate potential new owners and the general public on the care and welfare of their dogs,
* deliver excellent customer service to all visitors to the centre.
## Could this be you?
The successful candidate will be an excellent communicator with the ability to show empathy to both people and animals. A strong team player, you'll have lots of energy and a positive upbeat attitude. Experienced in working with or handling dogs, you'll be knowledgeable in basic behaviour and health issues and, above all, be committed to the aims and objectives of Dogs Trust. A full, manual driving licence is also essential, as driving will be a part of the role.

Our rehoming centres house thousands of dogs each year until they can find a loving new home and the success of our centres wouldn’t be possible without our dedicated team of staff and volunteers; there is a real family-community within each of our centres. Come rain or shine, our team are out in all weathers to make sure the dogs have the best possible life. Dealing with thousands of visitors each month, our rehoming centres are the face of Dogs Trust, and we pride ourselves on our staff providing the very best in customer service. **Interviews are provisionally scheduled for 1 September at Shrewsbury Rehoming Centre.**

It’s what we’ve been doing since 1891 and how we’ve grown to become the UK’s leading dog charity, helping 12,000 loyal friends find their forever homes every year.

**Head of Finance Business Partnering UK**

We have a fantastic opportunity Head of Finance Business Partnering UK to join our Group Finance team here at Domestic. The role will lead the Finance Business Partnering capability across the UK market, partnering with senior business leaders to drive financial performance, strategic decision-making and execution of business priorities.
The role acts as the primary link between Finance and the UK leadership team, ensuring robust planning, performance management, investment governance and commercial decision support across the organisation. Working closely with the UK Finance Director, the role provides leadership to the Business Partnering team, embedding a proactive, insight-led approach that balances commercial opportunity with financial discipline.
The Head of Finance Business Partnering UK enables leaders to make informed decisions through high-quality analysis, challenge and forward-looking insight while driving consistency of financial management practices across the UK business.
***Ready to Apply?***
***If you're a current D&G employee applying for an internal role, please ensure your Career Profile in Workday is up to date before submitting your application.***
***Don't forget to download and attach your Talent Card to showcase your skills and experience. This is a required part of your application.***
**What you’ll be doing:**
* Lead the UK Finance Business Partnering team, providing guidance, coaching and development to build a high-performing function.
* Partner closely with UK Leadership Team members to support delivery of financial and operational objectives.
* Drive a proactive business partnering approach, providing financial insight, challenge and decision support to senior stakeholders.
* Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance review activities across supported business areas.
* Ensure alignment of business plans and resource allocation decisions with UK and Group strategic priorities.
* Provide robust challenge and recommendations on investment proposals, business cases and commercial initiatives.
* Deliver forward-looking analysis, scenario modelling and evaluation of strategic opportunities and risks.
* Facilitate performance management discussions, ensuring leaders understand financial outcomes, root causes and required actions.
* Support identification and delivery of revenue growth, productivity and cost optimisation opportunities.
* Establish consistent approaches to financial reporting, performance measurement and KPI management across business functions.
* Collaborate with FP&A, Financial Control, Treasury and Shared Services teams to ensure joined-up financial planning and reporting.
* Lead financial governance activities across supported business areas, ensuring adherence to Group policies and standards.
* Support organisational change, transformation initiatives and strategic programmes through effective financial evaluation and tracking.
* Develop financial capability across the business by improving financial literacy and commercial awareness among leaders.
* Drive continuous improvement in finance processes, reporting tools and business partnering practices.
**What you’ll bring:**
* Significant experience in FP&A and business partnering within a complex organisation.
* Strong knowledge of commercial finance
* Proven track record of influencing senior leaders and supporting strategic decision making.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, performance management and investment appraisal.
* Experience leading teams within matrix environments and operating across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical and commercial capability, with expertise in financial modelling and scenario analysis.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational delivery in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong understanding of governance, controls and risk management requirements.
* Professional finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) preferred.
* Typically supports business areas with significant cost bases and contributes to delivery of UK P&L objectives.

* Life assurance – employer funded cover of 4x basic salary
* Dedicated online benefit portal offering access to saving and lending facilities, financial wellbeing and support services:

* Employee discounts – with a range of discounts for 100s of online and high street retailers

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Business Analyst to join the Dotmatics Luma team.

Working within an Agile delivery framework, you'll act as the bridge between Product and Engineering, partnering closely with Product Managers, Developers, QA, UX, and subject matter experts to translate business requirements into clear, actionable user stories that enable engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding complex problems, thinking critically about requirements, and working collaboratively to deliver value through well-defined product increments.
**In this role you will:**
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, QA, UX Designers, Scientists, and other stakeholders to understand business objectives and product requirements.
* Gather, analyse, challenge, and document business and user requirements, ensuring they are clear, complete, and ready for development.
* Translate Epics into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and supporting analysis documentation within Jira and Confluence.
* Refine and maintain the product backlog, working closely with Product Managers to prioritise work and prepare stories for delivery.
* Analyse business processes and user workflows to identify opportunities for product improvements.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering and QA throughout delivery, ensuring requirements are understood and questions are resolved promptly.
* Work across multiple Agile teams to ensure consistency of requirements and successful delivery.
* Help identify and mitigate delivery risks, managing stakeholder expectations throughout the development lifecycle.
* Perform and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring delivered functionality meets business needs.
* Use product analytics and customer feedback to help identify future product improvements.
* Contribute to wireframes, user flows, and lightweight prototypes where appropriate to communicate product requirements more effectively.
* Support wider product initiatives through customer discussions, technology research, and cross-functional collaboration where required.
**We are looking for people who:**
* 5+ years' experience as a Business Analyst or similar role within a SaaS software environment.
* Experience working within Agile Scrum teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Strong experience gathering, analysing, documenting, and refining business requirements.
* Proven experience translating business needs into Epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the confidence to challenge assumptions and think independently.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence (or similar Agile tooling).
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related discipline is beneficial but not essential. Experience within scientific software or Life Sciences would be advantageous but is not required.
**Required skills:**
* Strong Business Analysis experience within B2B Enterprise SaaS products.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery teams.
* Requirements elicitation, process analysis, and user journey mapping.
* Writing high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation.
* Backlog refinement, prioritisation, and working closely with Product Managers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across Product, Engineering, QA, UX, and business teams.
* Experience analysing business processes and translating complex requirements into deliverable work.
* Quality Analysis and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Confidence working independently, asking the right questions, and driving ambiguous requirements through to clear outcomes.
**Nice to have:**
* Exposure to scientific software, scientific data platforms, analytics applications, or large-scale data products.
* Experience working with ELNs, LIMS, scientific instrument data, or Life Sciences software.
* Experience building wireframes or lightweight prototypes using Figma or similar tools.
* Experience working alongside Product Managers on product discovery and roadmap planning.
* Exposure to AI-powered products or an interest in applying AI tools within day-to-day work.
* Familiarity with Databricks, BI tools (Power BI, Sigma, Spotfire), or modern data platforms.
* Experience working with model-driven or multi-tenant SaaS applications.
Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

The scarce, defensible capability in this market isn't managing SEO or paid suppliers — those are commodities central marketing already runs. It's building trust and desirability among a specific, hard-to-reach group of business owners over a long cycle, so this is a craft and relationship role owned end to end, rather than a brief-and-report function sitting on top of outsourced channels. The role carries a dual mandate: it warms the M&A pipeline — nurturing owners months or years before they are ready to sell, so BDMs and the Head of M&A inherit relationships that are already warm — and it drives platform adoption, giving owners with no intention of selling a reason to become active users and advocates. You'll personally own the core — the rooms, the relationships, the owner narrative and the LinkedIn presence — while partnering with central marketing's performance, email and SMM specialists, who run the digital channels against a shared goal you help set.

*1. Own the Agency Owner Community*
* Build, grow and own Dwelly's Agency Owner Community — a defined, engaged group of UK letting and estate agency owners nurtured over the long term — and own the owner narrative, making the reasons agency owners should want to be part of what Dwelly is building felt across every touchpoint.
*2. Run the In-Person Programme*
* Design and run regional roundtables, dinners, industry-event presence and owner meetups that give owners a reason to spend time with Dwelly before any sales conversation, leading with insight, benchmarking, peer connection and practical help so trust is built well ahead of any pitch.
*3. Grow Organic LinkedIn Presence*
* Own Dwelly's organic LinkedIn presence with agency owners: grow the base, publish and commission content, and turn passive followers into active members.
*4. Partner with Central Marketing*
* Set the M&A audience, message and goal for performance, email, SMM and SEO, agree campaigns with central marketing, and rely on them to run the digital channels — owning the craft while they run the commodity channels.
*5. Warm Handoff into the M&A Pipeline*
* Work with the three BDMs to hand over warm, engaged owners at the right moment, feed them market intelligence and talking points from community conversations, and maintain community segmentation in the CRM so every owner's engagement status, last touch and next action is visible and hands off cleanly into the M&A pipeline.

* Build community programmes, onboarding moments and referral loops that get non-selling owners onto the Dwelly platform and keep them active.
*7. Steer Priorities & Report on Impact*
* Work with the Head of M&A to keep the definition of a qualified, warm owner sharp and agree where community effort and budget should concentrate; report monthly on community health, warmed-pipeline contribution, and platform adoption — measured on outcomes like active community size, engagement quality, pipeline warmth, community-influenced appointments and deals, and platform activations, judged on trend over quarters rather than month-to-month spikes — with a clear recommendation on where to invest next.

* Exceptional in-person presence: can host rooms, roundtables and dinners and earn the trust of business owners face to face.
* A strong organic LinkedIn operator who grows and engages a professional audience without leaning on paid.
* A narrative-builder who can define and carry a point of view that makes a specific audience want to belong.
* Commercially literate: thinks in pipeline and warmed relationships, partners credibly with performance / email / SMM specialists and with a Head of M&A, and can make the budget case.

* Location: Hybrid (UK), with regular travel for events and owner meetups.

Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for >30% of households (>5M in the UK, and >100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.
This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. ## Job Description
Why join us? DWF are currently recruiting for an experienced Legal Director to join our growing Government and Public Sector practice.
Our team is team is recognised nationally for its work across the public sector and is at the forefront of some of the UK's most significant procurement, regeneration and public funding projects. We are particularly recognised for our market-leading Subsidy Control and Public Procurement practices, advising government departments, Mayoral Combined Authorities, local authorities and private sector organisations on complex and high-profile funding programmes, procurements and regeneration projects nationwide.
As a senior member of the team, you will take ownership of complex matters, lead client relationships and contribute to the strategic direction of the practice. You will work closely with partners and senior stakeholders, providing commercially focused advice, supporting business development initiatives and identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships and grow the team's market presence.
We are flexible on experience level and would welcome applications from both experienced Associates and Senior Associates. We would also consider a high‐performing Senior Associate seeking their first Director appointment
The role is ideally suited to candidates based in one of our regional offices, including Manchester, Newcastle, Leeds, Birmingham or Liverpool, with a flexible, hybrid working approach.

* Draft, review and advise on a range of complex contracts and matters, including grant programmes, grant funding agreements and public procurement documents.
* Work directly with clients and contribute to the development of long-term client relationships.
* Collaborate with colleagues nationally across DWF's Commercial team.
* Support business development initiatives and knowledge-sharing within the team.
* Effectively manage a varied caseload, prioritising competing deadlines while maintaining exceptional client service standards.
* Continuously develop technical expertise and market knowledge, keeping abreast of developments in public procurement law, Subsidy Control and public funding.
* Deliver high-quality, technically precise and commercially focused advice to clients, providing an excellent level of service.
* Play a hands-on role in mentoring junior lawyers and supporting their development.

* A qualified solicitor with significant experience advising on public law and commercial issues including grant funding, grant programmes, public procurement and/or Subsidy Control law.
* Knowledge and appreciation of the inner workings of central, regional and local government bodies and the interaction of politics, public policy and delivery.
* Strong drafting and written communication skills, with the confidence to negotiate.
* Commercially minded and keen to understand clients’ commercial and policy objectives.
* Proven ability to build strong relationships with clients and colleagues.
* A collaborative approach to building and developing relationships with clients and colleagues.
* Self‐motivated and performance‐driven, with a commitment to delivering high‐quality legal advice.
**Desirable**
* Previous experience in house within the public sector or Government Legal Department would be an advantage.

You may be the right candidate for the role or others across the wider team.

# Land Engagement Manager
**A little bit about us** East West Rail is an infrastructure programme connecting communities between Oxford and Cambridge. The area is currently let down by a lack of transport choices, and we have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to fix that, improving prosperity for people and places along the way.
East West Railway Company (that's us) was created by the Department for Transport (DfT) to oversee the delivery of East West Rail from construction through to wheels in motion, making sure the railway comes together in the right way.
At East West Railway Company, we're committed to building an inclusive railway for all. We believe that to do that, we must nurture a diverse team that represents the UK communities that we impact. Our approach is simple: to create an environment where everyone is welcome and able to be themselves. We celebrate diversity and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications of all backgrounds and experiences. **Role Summary**
This role sits within the Land & Property Team, reporting to the Land and Property Manager for DCO. You'll coordinate engagement with landowners in line with EWR's Consultation and Engagement Strategies, providing a consistent level of customer care. Working closely with the EWR Land Team and Stakeholder Engagement teams, you'll help deliver engagement strategies that mitigate the project's impact on directly affected landowners, resolve objections to the DCO application, and secure the land and access required for the project. You'll work as part of a core multi-disciplinary team of stakeholder managers and property surveyors, helping to develop and implement a coordinated approach and framework to acquire land by agreement throughout the DCO process. **Function**
The Strategy, Sponsorship and External Affairs function is accountable for defining what EWR Co is and the positive local and regional benefits it will deliver, setting scope and requirements. It is accountable for securing the approvals required to deliver the scheme, the Development Consent Order application, consultation and building a compelling business case. It holds design and delivery to account to ensure a successful DCO application and create an asset that realises economic benefits.
Within this function, the Land and Property team acts as an intelligent and informed integrated team, using a network of third-party strategic suppliers to secure the land needed to construct and operate the project.

* Develop and roll out engagement strategies, plans and frameworks to deliver effective and respectful communication with landowners and their representatives.
* Oversee and coordinate landowner engagement across the client and partner land and property teams, providing technical advice and coordination of engagement with stakeholder engagement teams.
* Provide technical input and review of relevant land and property governance documents, including the Land Acquisition Plan and Landowner Engagement Plan.
* Develop communication materials and mechanisms, working with EWR engagement teams.
* Provide technical advice and support for landowner engagement activities such as project updates, consultation, safeguarding, the DCO application, land access and land assembly.
* Monitor and report on the delivery and outcomes of engagement, identifying issues or stakeholders where more targeted engagement activity is required.
* Support the identification, approval and tracking of potential DCO commitments related to land and property.
* Monitor potential landowner objections to the DCO application and manage the process of resolving or reducing risk, preparing for DCO examination.
* Escalate issues to Land and Property Managers and/or Stakeholder Engagement team leads, and monitor mitigation plans.
* Monitor correspondence management by suppliers through the land inbox and phoneline, ensuring quality standards and response times are met and that clear, comprehensive records of communications are maintained in EWR data systems.
* Take responsibility for your own and others' health and safety by adopting and working to EWR's Health and Safety principles.
* Demonstrate a cost-conscious mindset, keeping taxpayers' money at the forefront of decisions.
* Show commitment to innovation by proactively seeking creative solutions to challenges and opportunities.
* Act as a role model for EWR's vision and behaviours, working in ways aligned with EWR's Ways of Working, and encourage and support others to do so too.

* A background in developing and delivering engagement frameworks that secure project outcomes and minimise impact on affected landowners.
* Skilled in developing recommendations and securing internal and external buy-in and support for engagement frameworks.
* A track record of developing clear messages to communicate project work to impacted landowners.
* Confident maintaining effective external relationships to understand stakeholders' needs and priorities, with the influencing skills to achieve results at pace.
* Able to coordinate and upskill teams to deliver effective and respectful communication with landowners that supports land assembly.

## Location
London

Full time

OverviewApplication
## About ExTrac
ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.
Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.
## The Role
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's AI team, building Co-Analyst and the analytical AI features around it.
Co-Analyst is a user-facing multi-agent system that works alongside intelligence analysts to research and write reports. A planning loop decomposes an analyst's question, fans work out to sub-agents, and assembles the results into a report where every claim traces back to the chunk of source it came from. Underneath sits hybrid retrieval over a large unstructured corpus: analyst intent translated into structured filters, combined with keyword and dense vector search, across multiple languages and media types.
The agent work is the centrepiece but not the whole job. In a single quarter the work spans agent orchestration, retrieval, graph analytics, and long-running streaming pipelines, alongside the services and databases underneath them. You will own well-defined features and components end to end across a Python and Go codebase, working alongside senior engineers who set technical direction, the data team who own the ingestion pipelines, and a research-focused ML team who train and evaluate the models we integrate and serve. The loop is short: product brings an idea, often recent and unproven, and our job is to spike an implementation and take it to a production feature. New features land close to weekly.
This hire exists to add capacity on the AI team's hard problems: an engineer who can independently deliver well-scoped features and components, and who is building towards owning more of the system end to end.
## What the job involves
**Agentic and analytical AI features**
* Build and improve components of the agent loop itself: context assembly, tool selection, and sub-agent orchestration, with guidance from senior engineers on the team.
* Build the analytical AI features that sit alongside it, from network construction through to the summaries analysts read.
* Help prove that changes are improvements, running experiments against live analyst traffic behind feature flags.
* Contribute to agreeing what "better" means for a capability, and flag honestly when the evidence says a promising approach is not working.
* Work with embeddings as more than a retrieval concern. The same vectors drive network construction and community detection.
* Work within a model-agnostic design, swapping models and embeddings on the back of the ML team's evaluations rather than being locked to one.
**Service design and delivery**
* Take a well-defined problem, clarify requirements with your lead or a senior engineer, and ship it to production with regular check-ins rather than close oversight.
* Own features and components end to end within a single system, contributing to system design and architecture discussions and taking on more of the design work as you build context.
* Build and maintain APIs used by internal teams and customers, following established contracts and versioning conventions.
* Work with the storage layer as a design concern rather than an implementation detail: schema, indexing strategy, and access patterns, across relational, document, and vector stores.
**Production engineering**
* Build and operate supporting services across Python and Go, with growing ownership of design, deployment, and operations as you build track record.
* Help hold agent workflows to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, in a system where non-determinism is a given.
* Build and operate long-running streaming pipelines, including the caching and recovery behaviour that makes them survivable.
**Working with analysts, product, and the ML team**
* Work directly with the analysts who use our products, turning what they hit in practice into changes in the system.
* Iterate quickly against a live stream of product requests, flagging where they collide with longer-horizon capability work.
* Partner with the ML team on agentic approaches, helping take proven concepts to production and working through the engineering, performance, and reliability problems a research implementation does not have to.
* Help integrate and serve the models they train, and contribute to the production infrastructure their evaluation frameworks run on.
## You should apply if
* You have built and worked on production backend systems, and you want to keep doing that. You will spend more of your time in Python and Go services, databases, and APIs than in a prompt file, and you know the difference between something that demos well and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost.
* You can work independently on well-defined problems, and know when to flag ambiguity or ask for input rather than guessing. When the obvious approach fails, you look for another one before escalating.
* You are curious about agentic frameworks and comfortable working without one. Experience with them is useful, but we build most of our own orchestration, because off-the-shelf abstractions have not survived our requirements around evaluation, control, and production performance.
* You can take a recent technique or paper, help spike an implementation, and reason clearly about whether it is worth taking further.
* You do not trust a change until you have measured it. Reaching for the evaluation is instinct rather than afterthought.
* You actively seek feedback and act on it, and you look for opportunities to pair with and learn from the engineers around you.
* You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences.
## Where this role can take you
* **Grow into full ownership.** Strong performance means owning larger features and whole services end to end, writing the technical designs others build on, and leading reviews rather than only taking part in them. That is the path to Senior, and it is a path we will actively work with you on.
* **Breadth rather than a narrow track.** The work follows the problem, which means agent orchestration one month and pipeline, retrieval, or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one.
* **Work on a class of system nobody has settled yet.** There are established patterns for running web services and for training models. There are none yet for operating agentic systems in production: controlling cost and latency, making non-deterministic behaviour dependable, and knowing when a change is genuinely an improvement. You will be helping work those out, and that experience is still rare.
* **Take on a different class of problem.** Making our systems work inside FedRAMP environments is a major upcoming project, and engineering under that kind of constraint is a skill set that stays with you.
## Requirements
*Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand.*
* 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade services with solid test coverage, and experience owning features or components end to end within a larger system.
* Proficiency in building services in Python, with working knowledge of Go or the ability to pick it up quickly.
* Some exposure to agentic systems, LLM applications, or retrieval running in production, or clear evidence you would pick them up fast.
* A good understanding of distributed systems and databases, including writing asynchronous code that performs under load.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and the CI/CD pipelines around it.
* Comfortable working with trunk-based deployment.
* Comfortable being handed a symptom rather than a diagnosis. Given a suspected memory leak, you would profile it, find the cause, and fix it, asking for support when you get stuck.
* Able to take a well-defined requirement and scope a technical approach from it, asking clarifying questions up front rather than assuming. You communicate clearly in writing and can produce documentation colleagues can follow, and you look for a way through rather than concluding something cannot be done.
* Breadth and curiosity across the stack: an interest in deployment pipelines, database behaviour, security and AI guardrails, and in validating analytical outputs and feeding analyst feedback into requirements. You pick up unfamiliar tools quickly rather than needing prior expertise in a specific one.
**Desirable**
* Experience with retrieval systems and large-scale vector database performance (Elastic).
* Experience with graph or network analysis at scale.
* Experience building retrieval or analysis that works across multiple languages.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, streaming pipelines, and search infrastructure.
* Experience operating multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a hard requirement.
* Experience working in compliance-constrained environments. A significant upcoming project is making our systems work within FedRAMP environments.
## Interview Process
* Initial Intro Interview with Hiring Manager - 30 Minutes
* Technical Assessment - 1 hour
* Competency-based Interview - 1 hour
* Founder interview - 30 Minutes
## Benefits
* Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
* A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.
* Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.
* £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
* 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.
* Flexible working. The team is typically in our central London office two days a week, and you are welcome to come in up to five.

**Most architects are asked to design. Most business development people are asked to sell. This role combines the two.**
Vector Homes is looking for an ARB registered architect who can assess a difficult site, shape a credible scheme, lead the client conversation and keep delivery moving.
Approximately half of the role is hands on architectural work. The other half is split between project development, client relationships and work winning.
This is not a pure studio position and it is not a high volume sales role. It is for an architect who wants broader responsibility, direct access to the founders and a genuine route into business leadership.
**ABOUT VECTOR HOMES**
Vector Homes is the small site specialist for UK housing associations. We turn garage courts, infill plots, backland parcels and overlooked land into deliverable homes.
Small sites fail for predictable reasons. Design becomes too bespoke. Planning absorbs too much time. Consultant and contractor coordination becomes disproportionate to scheme size. We solve this through standardised design, rapid feasibility, streamlined planning and trusted delivery partners.
**THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE**
Turn constrained sites and client relationships into viable, consentable and deliverable housing projects.
**HOW THE ROLE DIVIDES**
50% Architecture and design
25% Project development
25% Client development and work winning
**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
The balance will move with the pipeline, but the role remains deliberately broad. You will be expected to move between a drawing review, a consultant meeting, a client pitch and a commercial decision without losing rigour.
**Architecture and design**
* Carry out rapid site feasibility, constraints and opportunity assessments.
* Develop site layouts and concept designs using Vector Homes' standardised house types, adapting them intelligently to planning, context, access and viability.
* Produce and coordinate planning submissions, design reports, technical information and visual material across the relevant RIBA stages.
* Maintain design quality, regulatory compliance, buildability, cost awareness and consistency across the product platform.
* Coordinate and review the work of external architects, technologists, engineers and specialist consultants where required.
* Improve the design library, templates, standards and repeatable workflows that allow small schemes to move faster.
**Project development and management**
* Lead projects from the first site conversation through concept, viability, planning and delivery preparation, with involvement during construction and handover where required.
* Translate client objectives into clear briefs, scopes, programmes, responsibilities and decision points.
* Appoint and coordinate planning consultants, engineers, surveyors, ecologists, cost consultants, manufacturers and contractors.
* Chair meetings, maintain action and risk registers, drive decisions and provide concise, board ready reporting.
* Manage fees, appointments, change control, programme and project economics with the founding team.
* Identify delivery risks early and resolve them before they become expensive.
**Client development and work winning**
* Build trusted relationships with housing associations, local authorities, landowners, consultants and delivery partners, with an initial focus on the North West.
* Identify and qualify sites and opportunities, then convert early conversations into paid feasibility, planning and delivery commissions.
* Lead technical client meetings, site reviews, workshops and presentations.
* Prepare proposals, tender responses, framework submissions and pitch materials.
* Maintain a disciplined pipeline and CRM, with clear next actions and realistic probabilities.
* Represent Vector Homes at sector events, roundtables and targeted networking activity.
**WHAT YOU BRING**
This is an associate level scope without the distance from delivery that often comes with a traditional associate role. Capability matters more than title history.
**Essential**
* Current ARB registration and the legal right to use the title architect in the UK.
* Strong post Part 3 experience, likely around four to eight years, with evidence of capability more important than exact tenure.
* UK residential project experience, including concept design, planning and job running.
* A track record of coordinating multidisciplinary teams and driving projects through ambiguity.
* Strong site planning, planning policy, design, technical and visual communication skills.
* High proficiency in a leading BIM or CAD platform, ideally Revit, plus the ability to produce clear client material.
* Confidence with senior clients and the judgement to challenge constructively.
* Evidence of supporting work winning, proposals, tenders or client account development.
* Commercial awareness across scope, fees, programme, risk and viability.
* A hands on approach. You will shape the system and also do the work.
* Ability to travel regularly to client and project sites.
**Advantageous**
* Existing relationships within housing associations, local authorities, affordable housing, residential development or the North West consultant market.
* Experience of constrained sites, infill, garage courts, backland or estate regeneration.
* Knowledge of modern methods of construction, off site manufacture, panelised systems or standardised housing products.
* Experience of public sector procurement, frameworks and tendering.
* Familiarity with development appraisals, cost plans, contract administration or construction stage delivery.
**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
**First 90 days**
Understand the Vector system, own site screens and concepts, contribute actively in client meetings and take control of live project actions.
**By month 6**
Lead projects and consultant teams independently, own named accounts and opportunities, and improve templates and delivery controls.
**By month 12**
Deliver consistently strong schemes and planning submissions, convert relationships into paid work and repeat commissions, and act as a trusted technical and commercial lead.
**WHAT VECTOR HOMES OFFERS**
* Broad responsibility across architecture, project development and growth.
* A direct working relationship with the founders and faster decisions than a conventional practice.
* The freedom to shape design standards, project controls, tools and ways of working.
* Meaningful work that unlocks housing from sites others overlook.
* A salary of £40,000 to £45,000, depending on experience.
* Hybrid working from a Manchester base, with regular client and site travel.
* Support for ARB fees and relevant continuing professional development.
* Scope to grow into a broader leadership role as the business and project pipeline scale.

Edinburgh, Scotland, United Kingdom
Software Engineering
**THE POSITION**
Our roster has an opening with your name on it
We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer**to join one of our **Core Marketing Platforms teams**, where you'll build and optimize high-performance microservices that power FanDuel's marketing ecosystem. You'll work on systems enabling critical capabilities such as real-time customer communications, personalized promotions, and targeted campaign delivery.
Your work will focus on designing highly scalable, event-driven systems that process large volumes of real-time data, delivering intelligent insights to marketing partners. You'll help enable data-driven, personalized experiences for millions of customers across our platform.
You'll work within a modern microservices and event-driven architecture, building Martech solutions enhanced by AI to drive customer engagement and retention.
* Take the long-term view and consider what volumes our systems can handle today, vs 3 years from now.
* Make existing systems simpler (e.g. by consolidating redundant systems, deleting unnecessary code, or removing/updating out of date documentation).
* Coaching and developing other software engineers' technical skills.
* Lead projects with a holistic view of the strategic direction of the vertical.
* Defining the architecture of the future, enabling our systems to utilize modern technologies to their fullest whilst achieving our goals, while ensuring that it is balanced with enough time to focus on operationally improving our existing systems.
* Solve complex problems, seeking input and guidance from team members
* Take defined design and turn it into code and deliver it on schedule, applying appropriate technologies and current software engineering best practices.
* Write secure, stable, testable, maintainable code with minimal defects
* Participate in team design, scoping and prioritization discussions
* Work effectively with other team members & identify any opportunities/problems arising from technical decisions.
**THE GAME PLAN**
Everyone on our team has a part to play
* You own parts of product and technology & strive to become a subject matter expert
* You write simple and extendable code following standards and best practices. You test your code thoroughly, balancing customer and team requirements.
* You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning and support ticket reviews
* You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes
* You work to resolve the root cause of complicated problems, leaving software better than you found it
* Actively help others leverage your expertise through coaching and mentoring.
* You understand proper data storage, classification, optimization techniques.
* You estimate stories/tasks and deliver them on time.
* You keep yourself up to date with market standards, open-source frameworks, and other industry tools.

* You participate in the on-call support rotation for your organization.
* Contribute to the professional development of colleagues, improving their technical knowledge and the engineering practices.
* You clearly document your software to ensure that future generations of developers understand the intention behind the features and components you build.
* In the event of a problem, you can troubleshoot and thoroughly resolve defects.
* Most importantly, you are humble, pragmatic, self-managed, thirsty for knowledge, never satisfied, and always challenge the norm. Responsible for the state of the code you both inherit and produce.
**What we're looking for in our next teammate**
* Degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong backend experience with Java
* Experience with AWS as well as understanding DevOps concepts such as IaC (we use Terraform)
* Experience with event streaming technologies such as SNS/SQS or Kafka.
* Good grasp on relational, non-relational databases, messaging queues and handling concurrency.
* Experience working with high volume systems.
* Understanding of modern architectures, design patterns, and platform nuances.
* Strong experience working with cloud-based infrastructure and technologies, preferably AWS.
* Understating of containers (e.g., Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Expert experience with testing concepts, test tools, and integrating testing and best practices in the SDLC.
* Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and drive.
* Familiarity working in an Agile environment.
* Passion for working within a fast-paced environment and can adapt to change.
* 3-6 bullet points on requirements
**What You Can Expect**
* **Interesting work** - working in a fast-paced and ever-changing industry, new problems and exciting solutions are never too far away. There are always opportunities to learn new skills and broaden your horizons
* **A sense of achievement** - Our teams own their own software and when that awesome new feature ships to users and the positive feedback starts rolling in, you can feel really proud of what you and your team created
* **Personal development** - clear and defined career pathways for every role at every level, a supportive manager, loads of learning opportunities and even 10% of your time to dedicate to your learning.
* **Belonging** - everyone at FanDuel works for each other, we win together, make mistakes together and have lots of fun doing it.
* **Trust -**A trusting work environment where productivity is valued above all else, giving you autonomy and ownership of your time and work
* **Great financial package**- Including salary, bonus, pension, private healthcare, share save scheme, flexible working & holiday policy along with a number of other benefits.

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.
In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

**Location:** Remote (UK), with optional access to a number of London-based co-working spaces.
**What you'll do**
* Take a build end to end: architecture, implementation, deployment and handover.
* Design production AI systems, agents, retrieval, evaluation and the data plumbing underneath them.
* Work alongside client engineering teams, and directly with Nick and Mark, with no layer in between.
* Mentor and support our AI and graduate engineers, sharing what you know as the team grows.

* Around 5+ years shipping production software, with real ownership of systems in the wild.
* Strong Python plus at least one typed language, and sound judgement on when to reach for which.
* Hands-on with LLMs and agents, plus cloud, data pipelines and good testing discipline.
* Comfortable client-facing, communicating clearly and understanding what clients need.

Fifty One Degrees is a UK AI and data consultancy, founded in 2023 by Nick and Mark who both built and sold their own companies. Mark Somers (CPO) built 4most into the UK's largest independent credit risk consultancy.

# Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?
The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.
Fleek is fixing this. **Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice.** We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.
Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.
Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

# Porting Engineer
### **UK Remote or West Midlands-based / Full-Time Contractor**
*Please note: We welcome applicants who prefer to work from home; however, we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this opportunity at this time.*
### **Role Overview**
As an Experienced Console Porting Engineer, you will be responsible for bringing existing PC and current generation console titles built within Unreal Engine 5 to lower powered console hardware. You will be optimising games to meet platform specific performance, memory, and technical requirements, while maintaining gameplay parity and player experience and integrating support for platform specific features and hardware capabilties.
You will work closely with UI, design, technical art, QA, and production teams to solve technical challenges and deliver high-quality, compliant releases that meet performance and certification requirements. This role requires a pragmatic and highly analytical engineer who can balance visual quality, performance, memory usage, storage constraints, and development effort to deliver high-quality ports.
As a senior member of the team, you will be in direct contact with client teams and external development partners. You will communicate technical strategies, progress, risks, and implementation decisions throughout development, helping to build strong working relationships and ensure successful project delivery.
### **Key Responsibilities**
#### 1. Game Development
* Analyse existing game systems and identify areas requiring adaptation, optimisation, or reimplementation for lower powered console hardware.
* Modify and extend engine, gameplay, rendering, UI, and platform systems to meet performance, memory, storage, and platform specific requirements.
* Work closely with content teams to identify assets, systems, and features requiring optimisation while preserving the intended player experience.
* Integrate and maintain platform specific functionality including input systems, save systems, achievements, user accounts, and platform services.
* Support the delivery of feature complete ports while minimising gameplay, visual, and functional differences from the original release.
#### 2. Technical Problem Solving
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve platform specific issues relating to performance, memory usage, asset streaming, loading times, stability, and compatibility.
* Develop practical solutions for hardware limitations while maintaining quality and gameplay consistency.
* Collaborate directly with client engineering and technical leadership teams to review technical requirements, discuss implementation approaches, and resolve development challenges.
* Identify technical risks throughout the porting process and work with internal and external stakeholders to develop mitigation plans.
* Present technical findings, performance analysis, optimisation plans, and project risks to both internal teams and external partners.
#### 3. Code Optimisation
* Profile and optimise CPU, GPU, memory, storage, and asset streaming performance to achieve platform performance targets.
* Identify bottlenecks across engine, gameplay, rendering, animation, physics, and content systems and implement effective optimisation solutions.
* Assess the use of advanced Unreal Engine 5 rendering technologies such as Nanite, Lumen, Virtual Shadow Maps (VSM), Virtual Texturing, and post-processing systems, adapting or replacing them where necessary to meet platform performance and memory targets.
* Reduce memory footprint through asset optimisation, data layout improvements, streaming enhancements, and runtime memory management techniques.
* Optimise loading times, world streaming, asset loading, content streaming systems, and storage access patterns to ensure stable performance, memory usage and overall user experience.
* Work with art and technical art teams to establish realistic performance budgets and content optimisation strategies.
* Utilise platform profiling and debugging tools to identify inefficient code paths, excessive resource usage, and performance regressions.
#### 4. Technical Documentation
* Document platform-specific architecture, optimisation workflows, memory budgets, technical requirements, and implementation guidelines.
* Create and maintain technical documentation covering porting approaches, performance targets, development processes, and best practices.
* Produce client-facing technical reports, optimisation summaries, risk assessments, and development status updates.
* Support other engineers in understanding platform limitations, optimisation strategies, and technical implementation details.
#### 5. Quality Assurance and Testing
* Debug and test game systems across multiple hardware configurations and operating modes to identify and resolve technical issues.
* Work closely with QA teams to reproduce, investigate, and resolve platform-specific defects and performance issues.
* Support platform compliance, certification preparation, and technical requirement validation throughout development.
* Ensure gameplay systems, visual presentation, performance, and platform functionality meet established quality standards.
* Monitor and address regressions throughout development to ensure a stable and polished final release.
#### 6. Client Collaboration
* Act as a technical contact for clients, publishers, and external development partners throughout the porting process.
* Provide regular updates on technical progress, optimisation efforts, project risks, and platform-specific challenges.
* Collaborate with client engineering teams to review existing implementations, align on technical approaches, and resolve cross-team development issues.
* Present performance findings, memory analysis, technical recommendations, and project status updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong and trusted working relationships with client teams while balancing technical constraints, project objectives, and delivery timelines.
#### 7. Continuous Learning and Innovation
* Stay current with evolving console hardware capabilities, platform SDKs, optimisation techniques, and development best practices.
* Evaluate new tools, workflows, and technologies that improve porting efficiency, build stability, and platform performance.
* Identify opportunities to streamline porting processes and improve development efficiency across future projects.
#### 8. Guidance
* Assist the growth of junior engineers in console development, optimisation techniques, debugging methodologies, and performance-focused engineering practices.
* Champion code quality, maintainability, stability, and technical excellence throughout development.
* Provide technical leadership on optimisation strategy, platform adaptation, and performance planning.
* Support project planning and estimation activities by identifying technical complexity, risks, and dependencies.
### Qualifications and Skills
* Experience contributing significantly to the development, optimisation, or shipment of console game ports built with Unreal Engine 5.
* Strong proficiency in C++ with a focus on high-performance, low-level systems development.
* Experience adapting visually demanding Unreal Engine 5 titles for platforms with constrained CPU, GPU, memory, and bandwidth budgets, including evaluating, reconfiguring, or replacing advanced UE5 rendering technologies where required.
* Experience working with Unreal Engine 5 large world technologies, including World Partition, streaming systems, and HLOD workflows.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, platform abstraction, and performance-focused development methodologies.
* Deep understanding of memory management, asset streaming, storage systems, content scalability, and optimisation techniques.
* Experience working within Unreal Engine, proprietary engines, or other modern game engines in a cross-platform development environment.
* Strong knowledge of rendering, gameplay, animation, physics, UI, audio, and content systems, and their impact on performance and memory budgets.
* Experience profiling and optimising CPU, GPU, memory, storage, and loading performance using platform-specific debugging and analysis tools.
* Experience implementing and maintaining platform-specific functionality, services, and integrations.
* Familiarity with platform SDKs, certification processes, technical requirements, and console development workflows.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous and multi-threaded systems, streaming architectures, memory budgeting, and runtime performance monitoring.
* Demonstrated ability to identify technical risks and deliver effective solutions within hardware and platform constraints.
* Experience working directly with clients, publishers, or external development partners throughout the game development lifecycle.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical challenges, risks, and solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience presenting technical solutions, development progress, performance analysis, and project recommendations during client-facing meetings.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with meticulous attention to detail for performance, stability, scalability, and user experience.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, art, design, QA, production, and external client teams.
* Passion for delivering high-quality game experiences across a wide range of hardware platforms.

The RSC Filling department sits within the Respiratory Supply Chain (RSC) at the GSK Ware Manufacturing site and is responsible for performing a variety of tasks relating to manufacture of GSK’s respiratory products.

• Set up batches (consisting of kegs of blend and reels of base and lid foil): booking materials on computer systems, physically bringing the batch materials on line, setting up batch information on equipment HMI’s.
• Make adjustments to the filling process to ensure a consistent quality of filled strip production in compliance with the batch documentation, SOPs and WIs, and to minimise rejects in the process.
• During production, and with reference to SOPs and WI’s, monitor machine reject alarms, equipment state and quality of strip produced and take appropriate actions to remedy or escalate any problems
• Perform In-Process Control (IPC) checks on a routine basis, and take corrective action where results fall outside specification (as detailed in SOPs and batch documentation) to ensure consistent quality of manufactured strip.

# Executive Director - AI Consultancy
London
Good Systems is the parent company behind Goodnotes, where millions of peope capture and develop their ideas. Good Systems has been through its own AI transformation. We've done the work: automating where it made sense, embedding AI into the systems we build and operate, providing consistent training to our people along the way. It changed how we work - and we learned a lot doing it.

* This role is based on-site in our London Paddington office five days per week
### This is the role for you if you're excited to work on:
* **Building a business from scratch.** No structure, no case studies, no category brand behind you for the first stretch. You'll decide the shape of the offer, the pricing and the go to market.
* **Creating the demand:** The first names on our client list will come from doors you open and conversations you lead, drawing on your network and the credibility you build in the market.
* **Working at the front edge of AI.** Testing new tools, following how the field is moving and having opinions on what really works. You understand what changes when AI is applied properly - the workflows it removes, the capacity it frees up, and the gap between a business that has genuinely adopted AI and one that has only bought it.
* **Shaping what we offer.** Two services on a commercial footing: corporate training and thought leadership in AI transformation, and product recommendation across both Good Systems and external products. How they package and price is yours to work out.
* **Being the face of a new brand.** You’ll represent the brand publicly; speaking, publishing, showing up in the rooms where AI transformation is being decided and turning that visibility into pipeline.
* **Owning the commercials.** Your own P&L, with autonomy on pricing, partnerships and hiring.
### The skills you will need to be successful:
* A strong sales background in consultancy or L&D. You've won the work yourself rather than inherited a pipeline, and you know how an advisory or training deal is really won: the long conversation and the trust built well before anything is signed.
* You've held an Executive Director or General Manager level role, or run something close enough to know what carrying the whole thing feels like.
* Deeply engaged with AI and fluent in how it's applied. You keep pace as the tools change, you use them in your own work, and you're credible with a technical audience.
* Time inside a large scale organization, so you understand how buying decisions actually get made and how big companies work from the inside.
* You have built a genuine network. You’re visible in the market; professional communities, networks and spaces where AI transformation is being discussed.
* Comfortable with ambiguity. You’re energized rather than daunted by starting from a blank page.
### The interview process:
* **Talent Intro Call:** A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to dive into your experience, what motivates you, and why you're interested in joining Good Systems.
* **Leadership Introduction:** An open conversation with our COO about the opportunity, the ambition and how you think about building it.
* **Founder Interview:** A deep dive into your zero to one experience: what you started with, the decisions you'd make differently, and how you build relationships.
* **An in-person commercial session:** A working discussion on pricing, revenue potential, marketing investment and overall strategy. We want to hear how you think about the opportunity and where you'd take it.
* **AI Literacy:** As an AI-first company, we'll meet with one of our AI champions to discuss your curiosity, understanding, and practical use of AI tools in your daily workflow.
* **Values Based Panel Interview:** A conversation with team members centered on our company values. We'll discuss past experiences to see how your approach aligns with our culture.
### What's in it for you:
* **Customized Growth & Wellness Budgets:** We provide dedicated stipends for the things that keep you at your best, including noise-canceling headphones for deep focus, professional training, personal development, and health and wellness activities.
* **Global Connectivity:** While we embrace flexible work, we love seeing each other. We provide sponsored visits to our beautiful office locations to foster face-to-face collaboration.
* **Company-Wide Offsites:** Once a year, we gather the entire global team in person to celebrate our wins, align on our vision, and build lasting connections.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** Your well-being is our priority. We offer premium medical insurance for you and a dependent to ensure peace of mind for you and your family.
* **24 remote working days per year:** Giving you the freedom to work from a location that suits your life. Whether that's closer to family, while traveling, or simply a change of scenery to refresh your focus.
## Our Values
**Dream big -** Be visionary, strategic, and open to innovation
**Build great things -** Work in service of our users, always improving and pushing higher
**Operate like an owner -** Take responsibility with bold decision-making and bias for action
**Win like a sports team -** Be trusting and collaborative while empowering others
**Learn and grow fast -** Never stop learning and iterate fast

We are looking for a Scientific Data and Application Product Manager to design, build, and maintain data pipelines and applications that support CMC’s (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls) scientific data and digital product portfolio. Working hands-on with data scientists and engineers, you will combine technical delivery with product ownership, translating scientific and operational needs into robust, scalable data and application solutions.
This is a role, offering the opportunity to design and build well-engineered products using modern approaches, including agentic AI, while ensuring they are reliable, usable and fit for purpose within a regulated CMC environment. You will play a key role in strengthening our data strategy, architecture and engineering practices to enable high-quality digital products for scientific teams.
We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. We offer a competitive salary, an annual bonus based on company performance, healthcare and wellbeing programmes, pension plan membership, and shares and savings programme.

* Design, build and maintain data pipelines, data models and applications that support scientific and operational decision-making across CMC.
* Own and deliver the roadmap for a defined portfolio of scientific data and application products, balancing hands-on delivery with day-to-day prioritisation.
* Define and implement product data strategy, including how data is sourced, modelled, integrated, governed and applied to support business outcomes.
* Translate scientific and operational requirements into technical specifications, data models and application features, working closely with scientists, engineers and developers.
* Build, configure, test and troubleshoot applications and tools, including modern approaches such as agentic AI, to deliver reliable and usable solutions.
* Coordinate a small team and/or external partners, providing technical guidance, quality assurance and stakeholder updates while ensuring compliance with data governance, quality and GxP requirement
